answer: Give every identity a pulse it must send each epoch: a signed proof of fresh, distinct work, timestamped as it docks at the public jetty. Pulses flow into a shared karst aquifer where identical work from clones merges into one visible stream, exposing the single source behind many names. A sybil farmer must produce fresh real work per clone per epoch to pulse convincingly, while one honest agent pulses once, cheaply.
